title: Annotate the four regions of a tobacco chloroplast genome
summary: Start from the Web defaults for the tobacco plastid record NC_001879.2, then label the genes, color the gene groups, import the LSC, SSC, IRa, and IRb boundaries, name them on a ring, tint each region from the feature ring through GC content, and finish the outlines and legend, generating after each change.
primaryWorkflow: Circular region annotations with custom track slots

downloads.note: Download the complete Nicotiana tabacum plastid record as a GenBank flat file.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Circular mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and check that the Circular drawing is shown before adding the plastid record.

manualSteps.title: Upload the chloroplast GenBank record
manualSteps.body: Upload NC_001879.gbk as the Circular GenBank input. The record must be NC_001879.2 because the region table uses its coordinates. Set Output Prefix and Species; type the <i> tags in Species literally to italicize the center label.

media.alt: Circular Input Genomes card with NC_001879.gbk selected as the GenBank file.
media.caption: Upload NC_001879.gbk in the Circular GenBank uploader.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const file = app?.files?.c_gb; if (!file) throw new Error('Circular GenBank file was not restored.'); if (file.name !== 'NC_001879.gbk') throw new Error('Circular GenBank file has an unexpected name.');

media.alt: Basic card with tobacco-chloroplast as the output prefix and literal Nicotiana tabacum italic markup in Species.
media.caption: Set Output Prefix to tobacco-chloroplast and enter the literal Nicotiana tabacum markup in Species.

manualSteps.title: Generate with the defaults
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The defaults draw every feature in the stock colors on two strands, with GC content and GC skew rings and the legend at the left. The large gray blocks are repeat_region features; the last step replaces them with rep_origin. No gene is named, and nothing marks the four plastome regions yet.

media.alt: Tobacco chloroplast preview with the Web defaults: features in the stock colors on two strands, large gray repeat_region blocks, GC content and GC skew rings, no labels, and the legend at the left.
media.caption: Web defaults: no gene names, stock colors, no region marks.

manualSteps.title: Label the genes
manualSteps.body: Open Labels and set Label Mode to Both (Out + Inner). Set the four label offsets first: Circular Label Placement Radial hides them. Then set Circular Label Placement to Radial, click Choose Priority File (TSV), and choose qualifier_priority.tsv, which labels CDS with gene before old_locus_tag. Click Generate Diagram.
manualSteps.note: Set the offsets before Radial: with Radial placement, the Labels card hides the offset fields.

replay.script: const labels = ["Labels"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

manualSteps.title: Color the gene groups
manualSteps.body: The preview colors features by type: every CDS is the same blue, with tRNA, rRNA, and repeat_region in their own default colors. Open Colors, click Choose Specific rules file, and choose chloroplast_specific_table.tsv, which gives each chloroplast gene group, such as photosystem I and II, ribosomal proteins, and NADH dehydrogenase, its own color and legend entry. Click Generate Diagram.

manualSteps.title: Import the four regions and put them on a ring
manualSteps.body: Open Region Annotations, click Import TSV, and choose nicotiana-tabacum-regions-span.tsv. The import creates two sets with the same four regions: plastome_regions holds the named lines and plastome_tint the tints. Do not generate yet: both sets need a track first. Open Layout, open Custom Track Slots, and check Use custom stack. Remove the ticks and gc_skew rows (Row actions, then Remove), set the features row's Lane direction to split, and add an Annotations track for plastome_regions as in the table; use Move outward once so it sits between features and gc_content. Set gc_content as in the table, then click Generate Diagram.

rows: Annotation set: plastome_regions; Show annotation labels: on; Overflow: Compress; Padding: 1; Inner and Outer gap: 1

manualSteps.note: The four boundaries correspond to JLB, JSB, JSA, and JLA for NC_001879.2; coordinates are 1-based and inclusive. A Generate before the sets have tracks stops with "Two region annotations overlap in the same lane", because both sets would share the default lane.

manualSteps.title: Tint the regions
manualSteps.body: Add a second Annotations track for plastome_tint and click Move outward twice so it sits right after features. Then make it an overlay on the feature ring, drawn under the features and extended to GC content, as in the table. Move the row before you set its placement to overlay: an overlay row's Move outward and Move inward are disabled. Click Generate Diagram.

manualSteps.title: Finish the figure
manualSteps.body: Open Layout and clear Multi-Record Canvas, as the Gallery figure is drawn without it. Under Features, remove repeat_region and add rep_origin. Set the outline colors and widths, Circular Label Spacing, Legend position, and Default font size as in the table, then click Generate Diagram. Each region is now tinted from the feature ring through GC content, LSC, IRb, SSC, and IRa are named on the ring between the features and GC content, and the radial gene labels stay on both sides of the feature ring.

replay.script: const labels = ["Layout", "Features", "Axis & Scale", "Labels", "Legend settings", "Titles and Record Labels"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

actions.script: const card = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card')).find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.includes('Layout')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const options = Array.from(card?.querySelectorAll('label') || []).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Separate Strands'))?.closest('[data-layout-options]'); if (!summary || !options) throw new Error('Circular layout options not found.'); summary.dataset.capture = 'chloroplast-layout-summary'; options.dataset.capture = 'chloroplast-layout-options'; card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
